name: Motorcycle
description: A self-propelled vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, motor scooters included; with no light-motorcycle tier, a street-legal electric two-wheeler faster than a moped or limited-speed motorcycle is one whatever its power.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels; motor scooters are included, motor assisted bicycles aren't
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed; one with a top speed of 70 km/h or less may instead be a limited-speed motorcycle
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1); O. Reg. 340/94, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 16 or older with a class M licence, earned through the M1 and M2 stages
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 37(1); O. Reg. 340/94, ss. 2(1), 29(2)

restrictions.rule: An M1 rider may ride only in daylight, without passengers, with zero blood alcohol, and off roads with speed limits over 80 km/h except Highways 11, 17, 61, 69, 71, 101, 102, 144 and 655
restrictions.citation: O. Reg. 340/94, s. 7; Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 44.1(1)

restrictions.rule: Must be registered and plated, and carry liability insurance
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 7(1); Compulsory Automobile Insurance Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. C.25, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: Every rider must wear a motorcycle helmet with the chin strap fastened
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 104(1)

restrictions.rule: An electric motorcycle may use the 400-series highways, the Queen Elizabeth Way and the other controlled-access highways listed in Regulation 630 only if it was made after 2008 and is rated at 11 kW or more
A dealer may sell a new one only if it meets the federal Motor Vehicle Safety Act standards
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 105(1)

restrictions.rule: An electric dirt bike that isn't plated for the road is an off-road vehicle instead
